newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee steady vs dollar and firms vs stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee steady vs dollar and firms vs stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was steady against dollar and firmed against sterling on Thursday reflecting international market trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a commercial mean rate of 20.6165 to the dollar from 20.6295 on Wednesday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.6625 to the sterling from 33.742 on Wednesday.
Forex dealers said that the international market trends remained supportive to the dollar and the weakening of German mark was favourable to the strengthening of the dollar.
They added that weakening of sterling was associated with Bank of England chairman's statement on Wednesday saying that sterling was exaggerately strong.
Forex dealers said that on the local market there was no hard currency buying intention.
